plan.insight: Each entry of C is the dot product of a row of A with a column of B.
plan.user_changes: click a cell of C, new random matrices
plan.reacts: highlighted row and column, the per-term products, the selected entry

components.label: New matrices
components.onClick:
const m = (r, c) => range(r).map(() => range(c).map(() => randInt(7) - 3));
return { A: m(2, 3), B: m(3, 2) };

components.title: A × B = C (click a cell of C)
Terms a·b of the selected entry
components.draw:
const [r, c] = state.sel, t = state.A[r].map((a, k) => a * state.B[k][c]);
return [bars(t.map((v, k) => [k, v]), { labels: t.map((v, k) => `k=${k + 1}`), colors: t.map((v) => v >= 0 ? 'blue' : 'red') }), hline(0, { color: 'gray' })];

components.label: Selected entry of C
components.value:
const [r, c] = state.sel;
return dot(state.A[r], state.B.map((row) => row[c]));
